title: gymnopteris aurita
intro: Gymnopteris aurita, commonly known as the auriculated fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae, native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Gymnopteris aurita include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Gymnopteris aurita include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
